title: POPULATION PROGRAMMING INTERNSHIP
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 3 credits
description: Provides opportunities for students to deliver physical activity programming to different demographic populations through established organizations with direction by site supervisor and course instructor.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: KIN 193.
A minimum grade of C- is required in KIN 193.
